Alif-Lam-Mim.
Amaroma ayonqotshwa.
Ezanzi nezwe futhi bayophinde banqobe emuva kokunqotshwa kwabo.
Eminyakeni emithathu kuya kweyishumi. Ukulawula ngokuka Allah ekuqaleni nasemuva. Futhi ngalolo suku abakholwayo bayothokoza...
Ngosizo luka Allah. Usiza amthandayo futhi unguSomandla Onesihawu.
Isethembiso sika Allah, u Allah akasephuli isethembiso saKhe kepha iningi labantu abazi.
Bazi lokhu okosobala empilweni yasemhlabeni kulapho bengenandaba nekwelizayo.
Ingabe abajulanga bona ngokwabo na?. U Allah udale amazulu nomhlaba ngeqiniso nesukhathi esibekiwe. Impela iningi labantu abakholwa ukuthi bayohlangana neNkosi yabo.

Abazenge yini bahambe emhlabeni babheke ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salabo ababandulelayo. Babenamandla ukudlula bona futhi babephendula umhlaba futhi bawuphucula ukudlula bona. Zafika kubo iZithunywa zabo nezibonakaliso; akusiyena u Allah ongenzanga ubulungiswa kubo kepha yibona abangenzanga ubulungiswa kubona uqobo.
Isiphetho salabo abenza okubi kwaba esibi ngoba baphika imibiko yeThu futhi babehlekisa ngayo.
U Allah udala indalo eyisusa phansi bese eyiphinda, futhi niyobuyela kuYe.
Futhi ngosuku lapho iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] sesifika, izephula mthetho ziyodideka.
Bayobe bengesenaye oyobashwelezela kuzikhonzwa zabo, futhi bayoziphika izikhonzwa zabo.
Futhi ngosuku lapho iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] sifika; ngalolo suku bayohlukana.
Labo abakholwayo benza nokulingileyo, bayobe besesivandeni bejatshuliswa.
Kuthi labo abangakholwa baphika nemibiko yeThu nokuhlangana kwelizayo, laboke bayosiwa esijezisweni.
Ungcwele u Allah lapho kuhwalala nalapho kusa.
Futhi udumo lonke ngolwaKhe emazulwini nasemhlabeni, nasebusuku nasemini.
Ukhiqiza okuphilayo kokufile, aphinde akhiqize okufile kokuphilayo. Futhi uvuselela umhlaba emuva kokuba bewufile. Futhi nani niyokhishwa kanjalo [mhla nivuswa emathuneni].
Ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukuthi unidale ngenhlabathi nase naba ngabantu nasabalala.

Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukuthi wanidalela abalingani bohlobo lwenu ukuze nithole ukuthula kubo futhi wenza kwaba nothando nomusa phakathi kwenu. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abahlaziyayo.
Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukudalwa kwamazulu nomhlaba nokuhluka kwezilimi zenu nemibala yenu [yesikhumba]. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulabo abanolwazi.
Futhi ezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukulala kwenu ebusuku nasemini nokuthungatha kwenu umusa waKhe. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kubantu abezwayo.

Futhi kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe unibonisa umbani nesabe [ukushaywa yiwo] futhi nibe nethemba [lemvula]. Futhi wehlisa amanzi emvula avuselele ngawo umhlaba emuva kokuba ubusufile. Impela kulokho kunezibinakaliso kubantu abaqondayo.
Futhi kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe ukuthi isibhakabhaka nomhlaba kume ngomyalelo waKhe. Futhi kuyothi lapho enibiza kanye emhlabeni niyovele niphume.
Wonke osemazulwini nasemhlabeni ungowaKhe; bonke bathobela Yena.
Futhi nguYena owaqala indalo futhi uyophinda ayivuse [emuva kokufa kwayo], futhi kulula kakhulu kuYe. Kunjalo nje Yena unomfanekiso ophezulu emazulwini nasemhlabeni; futhi unguSomandla Okhaliphile.

Unenzele umzekelo ngani uqobo. Ingabe nina nezigqila zenu ningabalingani kulokho esinabele kona [kumcebo], ngokulingana, nibasaba njengoba nisaba nina uqobo [eningezigqila] na?. Siyicacisa kanjalo imibiko kubantu abaqondayo.
Empeleni laba abangenabulungiswa balandela izinkanuko zabo ngokungeqiniso. Ingabe-ke ubani oyohola lowo odukiswe ngu Allah na? Futhi akekho oyobasiza.
Bambelela enkolweni ngobumsulwa; ubambelele esimeni sobumsulwa sika Allah lesi adalela kuso abantu. Akekho oyoguqula indalo ka Allah. Leyo iyona ndlela eqondile kepha iningi labantu alazi.
Ngokuzinikela kuYe futhi nimuthobele. Niqikelele ukwenza iswala futhi ningabi ngababhangqi [abakhonza izyithixo].
Labo abahlakaza inkolo yabo babe ngamaqembu; lonke iqembu lijabule ngalokho elinakho.
Uma abantu behlelwa ubunzima bakhuleka ku Allah ngokuzinikela kuYe. Kepha uma esebazwise umusa ovela kuYe, ubona ngabanye babo sebebhangqa iNkosi yabo.
Ngaleyo ndlela bangakubongi lokhu esibaphe kona. Zijabuliseni, maduze nje nizokwazi.
Kumbe sibalethele ubufakazi obukhuluma ngalokho abakubhangqa naYe na?
Futhi uma sizwisa abantu umusa, bayajabulela. Kepha uma behlelwa umshophi ngenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zabo, bavele balahle ithemba.
Ababoni yini ukuthi u Allah wandisela futhi answinye amthandayo isondlo. Impela kulokho kuzibonakaliso kubantu abakholwayo.
Nikeza izihlobo okuyilungelo labo kanjalo nompofu nomhambi. Lokho yikona okungcono kakhulu kulabo abafuna Ubuso buka Allah futhi labo yibona abayophumelela.
Futhi konke lokhu okuyinzalo enikwengezayo emcebeni wabantu akusoze kwanda ku Allah. Kuthi lokhu enikhiphayo okuyizakati nilangazelele Ubuso buka Allah; yibona labo abayohlomula ngokuphindiwe.

U Allah nguYena onidalile banondla futhi nguYena othatha impilo yenu aphinde anivuse. Ingabe ukhona yini ongakwenza nakancane okunye kwalokho na? Ungcwele futhi uphakeme u Allah kunalokho abakubhangqayo.
Ukonakala sekudlangile ezweni nasolwandle ngenxa yemisebenzi yezandla zabantu; ukuze abazwise okunye kwalokho abakwenzile hleze bazisole.
Yithi: “Hambani emhlabeni, nibheke ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salaba baphambilini. Iningi labe lingababhagqayo [abakhonza izithixo].
Bambelela enkolweni eqondile lungakafiki usuku lolo ku Allah olungeke lwaphindiselwa emuva; ngalolo suku bayosabalala.
Lowo ongakholwa, ukungakholwa kwakhe makusale naye. Futhi labo owenza okulungileyo, baziphembela bona.
Ukuze ahlomulise emseni waKhe labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo; impela Yena akabathandi abangakholwa.

Kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe, ukuthi uthumela imimoya ethula izindaba ezinhle [zemvula], ukuze anizwise umusa waKhe nokuthi umkhumbi uhambe ngomyalelo waKhe nokuthi nizithungathelele ezibusisweni zaKhe, hleze nibonge.
Futhi sathumela iZithunywa kuzizwe zazo ngaphambi kwakho; zafika kubo nobufakazi. Kepha saziphindiselela kulabo abephula umthetho, futhi kumele sibasize laba abakholwayo.

U Allah uthumela imimoya esabalalisa amafu bese ewandlala esibhakabhakeni ngokuthanda kwaKhe awesenze amacozucozu; bese ubona imvula iphuma ngaphakathi kwawo. Ube eseyinisela loyo amthandayo ezigqileni zaKhe, kube yibo labaya sebejabula.
Nakuba ngaphambi kokuba ine kubo bebe sebengenalo ithemba.
Bheka nje imithethelela yomusa ka Allah, ukuthi uwuvuselela kanjani umhlaba emuva kokufa kwawo. Impela loyo uyakwazi nakanjani ukuvusa abafileyo futhi akehlulwa yilutho.
Futhi noma singathumela umoya, bazibone [izitshalo] ziba luphuzi [zifa]; bayolokhu beqhubeke njalo emuva kwakho lokho bengabongi.
Ngempela wena awukwazi ukwenza abafileyo bezwe futhi awukwazi ukwenza izimumu sizwe isimemo uma bebaleka bengenendaba.
Futhi awukwazi ukuhola izimpumputhe uyikhipe ekudukeni kwazo. Labo okuyibona ongabenza bakulalele yilabo abakholelwa kumibiko yeThu futhi bengaMamusilimu.
U Allah nguYena lona owanidala nibuthaka wase enipha amandla emuva kobuthaka waphinde wanenza emuvakokuba namandla nabuthaka naguga; udala akuthandayo futhi Unolwazi Unamandla.
Futhi ngosuku lapho sifika iSikhathi [sokwahlulela], iziphula mthetho ziyofunga zigomele ukuthi zahlala nje isikhashana [emangcwabeni]. Phela babedukiswa kanjalo.
Laba abanikwa ulwazi nokholo bayothi: “Ngokulotshiwe eNcwadini ka Allah, nihlale kwaze kwaba usuku lokuvuswa. Yilona-ke lolu usuku lokuvuswa kepha beningazi”.
Ngalolo suku, labo abaphambukile izizaba zabo ngeke zibasize ngalutho futhi abayikunikwa thuba lokuzincengela.
Impela zibenzele abantu yonke imizekelo kule Kurani. Kepha uma ubalethela umbiko owodwa laba abangakholwa bathi: “Niyazibhedele nje”.
U Allah uzivala kanjalo izinhliziyo zalaba abangenalwazi.
Ngakhoke, bekezela, ngokuba isethembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso futhi ungabavumeli bakuqede umoya laba abangenasiqiniseko.
